in_marathi.name: Sugam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Easy, smooth, sweet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sugam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sugam', which means 'easy', 'smooth', 'sweet'. This name is often given to a child born during a peaceful and harmonious time, or to one who is expected to bring joy and happiness to his or her family.
